title: Can You Go to Porto Santo by Boat From Madeira?
description: Yes, on the Lobo Marinho ferry from Funchal: about two and a half hours each way, out in the morning and back in the evening. A flight takes about 25 minutes.
heroAlt: The long golden sand beach of Porto Santo in soft morning light beside a calm turquoise sea
keywords: can you go to porto santo by boat from madeira
porto santo day trip from madeira
how far is porto santo from madeira
